name: CI: Lint PHP (PHPCS + optional PHPStan)
description: GitHub Actions workflow that calls rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows ci-lint-php.yml. Runs PHPCS (and optionally PHPStan) over changed files in a PR, or the whole project on push. Calls `@v1` by default.

inputs.description: Tag or ref of rtCamp/wp-shared-workflows to call. Pin a major tag such as `v1`, never a branch: branches move or get deleted.
Run PHPStan after PHPCS. Pass 'true' or 'false'.
